notes.title: Game balancing adjustment and bugs hotfix
notes.content:
Hello gamers!

Small fix and game balance adjustments for today.

- The possibility of anomalies and jumpscares on upper floors has been reduced.
- The probability of anomalies and jumpscares has increased as you descend to the lower floors.
- In rare cases, the mouse may become locked in events that cause the player to look at the jumpscare. For this purpose, a mouse bug fix button has been added. If you experience this bug, press R to get rid of it.

If you have any suggestions or problems, let me know!

Thanks!
